event_name: Get 'Reckless' this weekend at Hotel Sweeneys
date_text: Thu, Jun 25th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jun 28th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Fresh from Bathurst and one of regional NSW’s most exciting independent breweries, Reckless Brewing is rolling into Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop with 10 kegs of pure deliciousness. Founded by a passionate team of mates and now a proudly majority women-owned brewery, Reckless has built a reputation for producing award-winning beers while becoming a much-loved part of the Bathurst community. And they’re bringing the good stuff to Sydney. From crisp West Coast Pilsners and juicy New World Pale Ales, right through to the weird and wonderful — including an Iced Vanilla Latte Stout, a Bloody Mary Double Gose, and a limited collab Black IPA. Join us Thursday night when Dan from Reckless hits the rooftop armed with his famous Chocolate Wheel, spinning out prizes and giveaways throughout the evening. Can’t make Thursday? No stress. The beers will continue pouring all weekend until the kegs run dry - Get Reckless at Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop this week. Tap List: - WCIPA Black IPA x Sea Legs 7% - Bloody Mary Double Gose 6.5% - BX Lager 4.40% - Chocolate Milk Stout 5.50% - Hazy Pale 4.70% - Iced Vanilla Latte Stout 5.50% - New World IPA 7% - New World Pale 5.20% - Red IPA 6.50% - West Coast Pils 5.20% - XPA 4.20%
